sections.html: The "Mustang Shrimp" is a very pretty, black-and-white dwarf shrimp. According to Werner Klotz, the "godfather of dwarf shrimps", it belongs to the species Paracaridina zijinica. Regarding keeping and breeding, it does not differ from the well-known dwarf shrimp "Crystal Red".

The Crystal Red, the first dwarf shrimp that appeared on the market at all, has finally been described scientifically as Caridina logemanni Klotz & van Rintelen, 2014, named in honour of the brothers Logemann, well-known dwarf shrimp breeders.

In the same work, the well-known Tiger Shrimp was named Caridina mariae Klotz & van Rintelen, 2014, dedicated to Maria, the wife of Werner Klotz.

Klotz, W. & T. van Rintelen (2014): To "bee" or not to be – on some ornamental shrimp from Guangdong Province, Southern China and Hong Kong SAR, with descriptions of three new species. Zootaxa 3889 (2): 151-184
